1. src/renderer/src/i18n/locales/*.json, src/renderer/src/i18n/translate/*.json — Massive scope creep unrelated to the stated bug fix: deletes/rewrites the entire `shortcuts` i18n key set (removing `title`, `label`, `reset_defaults`, `show_app`, `zoom_in`, etc.) across every locale and introduces literal `"[to be translated]:..."` placeholder strings and raw Chinese text as "English/French/Greek/etc." translations. This will visibly break the UI for every non-Chinese locale and likely break any code still referencing the removed keys (e.g. `settings.shortcuts.title`, `reset_defaults`). Must be reverted — the mini-app cache fix should not touch i18n files at all.

2. src/renderer/src/pages/home/Navbar.tsx, src/renderer/src/components/ShortcutsHelp/ShortcutsHelp.tsx, src/renderer/src/store/shortcuts.ts, src/renderer/src/i18n/label.ts — Entirely unrelated feature (tab-switch shortcuts Cmd+1..9, shortcuts-help modal) bundled into a PR titled/scoped as a mini-app cache bug fix. This violates single-purpose PR scope, makes review/revert risky, and isn't mentioned anywhere in the PR description. Must be split into its own PR or removed.

3. PR_TEMPLATE.md — A duplicate of the PR description committed as a new file at repo root. This is not a real contribution and shouldn't be merged; remove the file.

4. src/renderer/src/pages/home/Navbar.tsx — `switchToTab` indexes into `tabs` by raw position (`tabs[index].id`) with no bounds/identity semantics tied to visible tab order, and binds `Cmd/Ctrl+1-9` unconditionally; this can conflict with OS/browser-reserved shortcuts and with existing app shortcuts, and there's no check for whether tabs feature is even in scope for this fix. Should be dropped entirely from this PR per point 2.

5. src/renderer/src/pages/minapps/MinAppPage.tsx — `setHasHandledRedirect(false)` reset effect depends on `[appId, isTopNavbar]`, but `appId` is presumably derived from `useParams()` (not shown) — if that identifier isn't actually a dependency used elsewhere consistently (e.g., the `app` lookup uses `app.id`, not `appId`), there's a latent risk the guard resets for the wrong key. Confirm `appId` is the correct, stable identity source and that the subsequent `useEffect` (using `app`) and this reset effect can't race (reset fires, then `app` effect hasn't re-run yet) causing a flash of popup/tab logic. At minimum, add a short comment/test showing the ordering is safe.

6. src/renderer/src/pages/minapps/MinAppPage.tsx — The early return `if (!app || !isTopNavbar) return null` now reruns on every `isTopNavbar` toggle while mounted; combined with the redirect effect firing `navigate('/apps')` plus a `setTimeout` popup open, switching nav modes while a cached top-nav tab is open could trigger an unexpected redirect/popup rather than just re-parenting the cached view. The PR's "testing" checklist claims this was manually verified but no automated test was added despite the checklist claiming "added tests that prove my fix is effective" — no test files appear in the diff. Either add a regression test or correct the checklist.

7. CONTRIBUTING.md convention — No tests were actually added despite checkboxes claiming "I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works" and "I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas" (no new comments of substance, no test files in diff). PR description checklist is inaccurate and should be corrected or tests added before merge.
